notes.title: Overhaul of existing content
notes.notes:
It has been a long time since I last updated the game. And now I am going to outline exactly what I will do, according to feedback.

It seems like having more content is not a priority, but instead for the existing content to be overhauled and made better. So, here's my plan of action going forward.

[list]
[*] Quest markers for those who get stuck. Some people did get stuck on various tasks, and implementing it should be feasible.
[*] Research into what is causing the random "Exception Access Violation" crashing.
[*] Further optimise the game for lower-end PCs.
[/list]

In terms of the content itself, there will only be one final episode. My ambitious vision for all 13 episodes and hundreds of hours of gameplay, is not feasible for a solo developer. Instead, the full game will be a short but polished experience.

I intend to make an update within a month or two, with at least most of what I have planned.
